### 1. What the user expresses and how the simulator behaves

- Opening (simulator line per script): new system goes in on Thursday; wants "to pay what is due before the installation, from your checking account". Target object = the replacement-installation project; timing = now, ahead of installation; boundary = pay what is due ahead of installation (amount unknown to him); method = ACH ("straight out of your checking account by ACH").
- Identity: name + phone 6145554362; second detail street address 4518 Leppert Rd (PIN 2864 only if asked). `verify_customer_identity(customer_id, phone_number, service_address)` -> "Identity verified".
- Passive conditional facts: financing (18-month no-interest, $8000, approved the day after signing) only if asked; Gold member only if asked; what each change order was for only if asked — CO 1 extra ductwork okayed the evening he signed; CO 2 "a new copper line set" okayed on the install manager's tablet last Thursday. If told a copper-line-set change order must be put on the account first and its amount, he says go ahead. He does not raise change orders, credits or fees himself.
- User tool execution: when handed the payment with an amount, he pays it himself by ACH for exactly that amount and reads back the confirmation reference. The simulator does not push the procedure.

### 4. Scored parameters

**(a) Line-set change-order charge for CO 2** — computation document `line_set_change_order_price_65c69fc8`: "the line-set change-order charge is the package's line-set change-order price, rounded to the cent half up"; package price on the rate card (`change_order_rate_card_0639d2ab`): Harbison Advantage Series System $895.00. Factor documents and their tiers, found from the records:
- Refrigerant-history credit (`refrigerant_history_credit_da59ea04`), found from the service-call invoice lines of type `refrigerant` and `repair_labor` task `refrigerant_leak_search` (Repair and Emergency Service Calls records): leak search labor and refrigerant both billed in the 24 months -> "the credit is the refrigerant leak search labor billed on them … the total of every such labor line" -> 349.00. - Discovery share (`discovery_share_e5f26b5b`), found from the change-order approval date / permit-fee posting date / signing date: most recent confirmed approval 2026-10-01, permit-fee charge posted 2026-09-24, signed 2026-09-14 -> "confirmed on or after the day the project was scheduled … 60 percent".

- Promotional-financing fee (`promotional_financing_fee_a5082f65`), found from the Home Comfort Financing account record: approved, 18-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan -> 4 %.
- Change-order administration fee (`change_order_administration_fee_c3454172`), found from the change-order charges on the ledger: exactly one already posted (CO 1) -> $45.00.

Computation: 895.00 − 349.00 = 546.00; × 60 % = 327.60; − 15 % (49.14) = 278.46; + 4 % (11.1384) = 289.5984; + 45.00 = 334.5984; rounded half up -> **334.60**.

**(b) Progress installment** — computation document `progress_installment_amount_8bc331b6`: "30 percent of the project's net amount, which is every charge on the project less every credit on it, rounded to the cent half up"; payments are not part of the net amount. Order: net − excluded − charges collected in full (not below zero) -> × share -> × multiplier -> + charges collected in full -> round.

After CO 2 is charged: charges 11295.00 + 228.00 + 105.00 + 334.60 = 11962.60; credits 400.00 (member_install_credit) -> net amount 11562.60.

Factor documents and tiers:
- Financed exclusion (`financed_amount_exclusion_d0c6c7f9`), found from the Home Comfort Financing account linked to the project: approved, 8000.00 < 11562.60 -> exclude 8000.00.
- Change-order collection (`change_order_collection_with_progress_52f72ab8`), found from the change-order approval requests (confirmed status) and change-order charges: exactly 2 confirmed -> the highest-numbered charge (CO 2, 334.60) collected in full; CO 1 (228.00) stays at the share.
- Progress share by project size (`progress_share_by_project_size_ab12e224`), found from the ledger charge total: 11962.60, at least 11000 and below 15000 -> 40 %.
- Upkeep multiplier (`tune_up_upkeep_multiplier_afa15ef2`), found from the Comfort Club visit history (completed tune-ups): 3 in the 24 months before 2026-10-05 -> 0.9.

Computation: 11562.60 − 8000.00 − 334.60 = 3228.00; × 40 % = 1291.20; × 0.9 = 1162.08; + 334.60 = 1496.68 -> **1496.68**.

Fall-back numbers (computation documents only, no factor): line set 895.00 (vs 334.60); progress installment with CO 2 at 895.00 = 30 % × (12523.00 − 400.00) = 3636.90; with CO 2 omitted = 30 % × 11228.00 = 3368.40; with the correct CO 2 charge but no factor = 30 % × 11562.60 = 3468.78. All definite and all different from 1496.68.

Findability of factor documents: each was reached from record vocabulary — "refrigerant leak search"/"refrigerant" lines on Repair and Emergency Service Calls invoices; "change-order approval" confirmed date and "permit-fee charge" posting date; Comfort Club "consecutive terms"; Home Comfort Financing account "approved"/plan name; "change-order charges already posted"; "amount financed"; "confirmed approvals"; "total of every charge"; "completed tune-up visits". `kb_search "refrigerant leak search line set credit"` returns the refrigerant-history credit document first. - Closest alternative object: "pay the remaining balance / whole balance before installation" — excluded by `progress_installment_payment_8efe8428` ("takes a progress installment … ahead of its installation day, and the rest of the balance is due … after the installation date, where 0 means on the installation day") and by the financing disbursement posting only once installed (`financing_on_installation_projects_df750b27`). "Pay a contract deposit" — excluded, deposit already on the ledger (1307.40, 2026-09-14) and the project is scheduled.
- Closest alternative billing: CO 2 as duct or "other scope" — excluded by the customer's statement (copper line set) and the package inclusions (line set not included on Advantage); CO 2 at the bare $895.00 — excluded because each factor document's tier rests on the customer's records (above).
- Closest alternative share date: approval 2026-10-01 vs CO 1 2026-09-14 — the discovery-share document reads "the most recent change-order approval confirmed on the project", so 2026-10-01; scheduling date = permit-fee posting 2026-09-24 -> 60 %.
- Closest alternative windows: tune-up visit 2024-09-26 and refrigerant 2024-06-11 fall outside the 24 months before 2026-10-05.
- "Do only what the customer asked" (compute and take the progress installment without charging CO 2): excluded — the hub's own ledger condition says the installment is not fixed while a confirmed change order has no charge, and the records show confirmed CO 2 without a charge.
